Lesson 6 Assembly of 4WD Smart Car
           with Mecanum Wheels

6.1 Assemble the Robot's Body

1. Place four M2.5*6+6 Copper Standoffs on the holes of part A01, and then fix
them with four M2.5*7 Screws.

  A01

 Assemble the following components:
 Note: This component is not symmetrical, so please be careful to identify the
 mounting surface of the part.

8.Fix the assembled DC Motor onto part A02 with DC Motor Mounting Bracket
(The bracket kit contains matching M3*8 Screw,M3*30 Screw and M3 Nut).
NOTE: Due to the opposite polarity of the left and right motors, during installation,
it is necessary to ensure that the colors of the motor wires on the same side are
consistent, while those on the opposite side are opposite, ensuring that the
mounting positions of all parts are correct.

DC Motor Mounting Bracket

                                              of the motor wires.

into the corresponding slot on the Raspberry Pi board!!!)

36

    X  O

Note: The Mecanum wheel car adopts the O-rectangle assembly method. The

actual wheel is "X" when viewed from above, and is "O" when it is actually in

contact with the ground. (looking up from below the Mecanum wheel car)
